from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyDebtInfo(BaseModel):
    """Total liabilities information from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name from the financial report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Security code if provided in the document")
    total_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="Total liabilities amount as reported in the document")
    liabilities_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the liabilities figure: e.g., 'yuan', 'ten_thousands', 'millions'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned in the document")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the liabilities figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_debt_info: list[CompanyDebtInfo]
